purpose: Inventory real measured injection-moulding datasets and data-bearing studies without conflating public metadata, downloadable files, reuse rights, record units, or independent experimental evidence.

datasets.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding
datasets.statusNote: Completed benchmark; exact workbook fingerprint and 26-field normalized result retained without raw rows.

datasets.title: High-resolution injection-moulding time-series datasets (scatimdata)
datasets.statusNote: Top high-frequency benchmark target; paper and repository are one experiment family and count once.

datasets.title: Hot-runner molded sustainable-material experimental supplementary data
datasets.statusNote: Public supplementary table; includes a recycled-PP blend and bioplastics in a two-cavity hot-runner experiment.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels
datasets.statusNote: Publicly downloadable B2SHARE record; current record exposes no explicit licence text, so verify reuse rights before automated ingestion or redistribution.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)
datasets.statusNote: Publicly downloadable B2SHARE record; current record exposes no explicit licence text, so rights must be confirmed before automated use.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
datasets.statusNote: Excellent waveform source; current B2SHARE result is open but licence text must be checked before repo ingestion.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Process Data for Post-Consumer-Recycled Materials
datasets.sampling: time-resolved; exact cycle count to enumerate from archive
datasets.statusNote: Public download is available; exact reuse terms should be captured from the versioned repository record before redistribution.

datasets.title: ImPure Injection Molding Sensor Data - Trial 17th May

count.cycleFiles: hundreds; exact count must be enumerated

datasets.sampling: one CSV per moulding cycle plus trial/stage files
datasets.statusNote: Open-access Zenodo archive with cycle-numbered CSVs; profile exact sensor columns/cycle count and verify licence before ingestion.

datasets.title: Plastic road-lens injection-moulding quality dataset
datasets.license: Freely released for research and educational purposes; not a standard OSI/data licence
datasets.sampling: one process feature vector per lens
datasets.statusNote: Very useful simple real-production benchmark; use under stated research/education terms and avoid assuming broader redistribution rights.

datasets.title: OpenMMS-T4G real mould-monitoring case data
datasets.sampling: mould-side monitoring time series; exact case-cycle segmentation to profile
datasets.statusNote: Good mould-side sensing benchmark; enumerate the raw case-study file before any cycle-count claim.

datasets.title: FORinFPRO-HIMD multimodal hybrid injection-moulding sensor dataset
datasets.statusNote: Extremely rich sensor depth but current visible v1 file set is cycle_001; verify licence and future versions before scale claims.

datasets.title: Cross-process-chain dataset archive: injection molding and screw driving
datasets.sampling: injection time series approximately 1 kHz in documented subsets
datasets.statusNote: Do not count downstream screw-driving observations as injection cycles; enumerate injection experiment IDs and verify licence first.

datasets.title: KAMP injection-moulding factory dataset
datasets.statusNote: Useful real-factory data but GitHub analysis-code licensing does not automatically prove redistribution rights for the original KAMP dataset.

datasets.title: Foxconn industrial injection-moulding competition dataset
datasets.sampling: cycle traces approximately 40–43 s plus scalar status/settings
datasets.statusNote: High-value industrial source; public mirrors must not be treated as independent datasets or redistributed until original competition rights are established.

datasets.title: High-speed demoulding/ejection experimental dataset
datasets.sampling: high-speed DAQ; exact trials and channels to profile
datasets.statusNote: Specialist ejection evidence; Origin project format requires a dedicated adapter or export step.

datasets.title: Preform injection molding analysis - Database
quality: process/quality study fields to profile from actual files
datasets.sampling: record-level database; exact schema/count not yet profiled
datasets.statusNote: Reuse-ready by licence, but actual files must be inspected before assigning units, cycle semantics or mechanism labels.

datasets.title: Injection-Molded Polypropylene Parts: Experimental Process Dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.statusNote: Raw files unavailable until 2027-12-31; metadata visibility or CC BY metadata does not make the current files executable.

datasets.title: Injection-molded plastic parts defect dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.recordUnit: injected part/image linked to parameter configuration
datasets.statusNote: Raw files unavailable until 2027-12-31; retain only metadata until embargo ends and live rights are rechecked.

datasets.title: Industry 4.0 In-Line AI Quality Control of Plastic Injection Molded Parts experimental data
datasets.sampling: multi-rate machine and in-mould sensor data
datasets.statusNote: Excellent measured evidence; data availability is by request from corresponding authors, not an open executable benchmark.

datasets.title: Industrial bottle-cap quality-deterioration production data
datasets.statusNote: Strong real-production evidence but raw data are confidential; use the paper as Tier B evidence rather than pretending the rows are available.
